hook_text: These plans have no pictures of lights or plugs. Just lines, circles and crosses. Can you crack the code?
clip_script: A new hall in Phuthaditjhaba. The electrician's plans: a secret code that every electrician in the world can read! A long line and a short line: a cell, long line positive. A circle with a cross: a bulb. A little gate: a switch. Open gate means off, shut gate means on. A circle with an M: a motor. Straight lines, square corners, no gaps. Now you can read it too!
visual_style: Whiteboard plan with symbols appearing one by one and labels popping up, then a rectangle diagram with an open-gate switch.
mood: Mysterious, then empowering, like cracking a code.
pacing: The mystery plan, the symbols one by one, then reading a full diagram.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and draw the diagram for a torch.
